results.notes: Fresh wizard, Brand analysis, custom brand "Lictorix Geo" via the "— Custom Brand" row. Given: span lettermark "L" bg-green-500 32x32, website field empty. Typing "licter.com" (120 ms/key, sampled after each key): avatar stayed the span "L", 0 lookup requests. On blur: span "h-8 w-8 shrink-0 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-slate-200" 32x32, empty text, x unchanged (475); "licter.com" appears under the name at the same time (card 54 -> 61 px for the domain line, avatar stays 32x32 - same as the 09:18 run). The /brands/logo response was held with a Playwright route (test aid, response body unchanged) to capture the placeholder; the first route handler errored and the request was released by unroute, the response remained {"domain":"licter.com"}. Then src https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com&sz=64 (natural 64x64, rendered 32x32). Network: exactly one GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com -> 200 {"domain":"licter.com"}, then s2/favicons (301) -> t2.gstatic.com faviconV2 (200). Request names: "brands/logo" (lookup) and "s2/favicons" (image). Nothing submitted, no analysis created.

results.notes: Same wizard after TC-001: website field cleared and blurred -> avatar back to span "L" 32x32, no domain line. W3 typed "sqlite.org" (100 ms/key), blur: animate-pulse bg-slate-200 placeholder 32x32 (step2_when, 2.5 s route delay, response unchanged). One GET /brands/logo?domain=sqlite.org -> 200 {"domain":"sqlite.org"}, then src https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=sqlite.org&sz=64 (natural 16x16, rendered 32x32, SQLite favicon) instead of "L"; "sqlite.org" under the brand name. The favicon fallback behaves as expected, but the discriminating condition (logo service has logos for other domains) is not available on staging.
